plan: A support who protects her allies with her shields and pushes everyone away with her tornadoes.
aSurveiller: Her R (Monsoon). She knocks back every enemy around her then heals her allies: don't engage on her at that moment.
contrer: Don't engage while she has her R: it knocks everyone back.
Her tornado (Q) grows before it flies: step out of its path.
Attack her first: she is fragile.
faiblesses: Her R is channelled and can be interrupted.

sorts.P: Her allies move faster towards her.
sorts.E: Shield on an ally or a turret.
sorts.R: Knocks enemies back then heals her allies.

momentFort: Useful from the start, very strong in team fights.
